summary: refactor(eslint): remove unused mocha ast helpers
description:
Because:

- The mocha detection helpers have no callers; `no-exclusive-tests` only uses
  `getNodeName` and `getPropertyName`.
- Ramda 0.30 flipped the `propEq`/`pathEq` argument order, so
  `isCallExpression` and `findReference` had been returning false anyway.

This commit:

- Deletes the unused helpers from `util/ast`.
- Narrows the new unit tests to the two helpers the rule uses.
